dialogues.speaker: Moriguchi
dialogues.text: My wife is on Watatsumi Island. I have to serve here because of the war, so we've been separated.

dialogues.speaker: Moriguchi
dialogues.text: The Vision Hunt Decree has not only hurt people with Visions, but also the commoners like us. Damn this stupid law.

dialogues.speaker: Moriguchi
dialogues.text: I just feel like I've spent too long on the battlefield. I've almost forgotten what the blissful life we had as a couple was like...
